classification.difficultyReason: Determine the downward vertical change from 5 to -2 and horizontal change from 0 to 3, then apply the taught rise/run calculation.

content.prompt:
Leo drew a straight line through the points $(0,5)$ and $(3,-2)$.
What is the gradient of the line?

spec.description: Square unit grid from x = -3 to 6 and y = -5 to 6, with every nonzero integer labelled. Positive-direction axis arrowheads and x/y labels. A black descending line has arrowheads beyond both marked points.
spec.mathematics: The marked points are (0,5) and (3,-2). The straight line is y = 5 - 7x/3. Its unlabelled arrow extensions are reconstructed approximately from the source; they introduce no additional givens.
spec.answerVisibility: The graph and both marked points are permanent student-visible givens. No gradient or rise/run annotations are supplied.
